services.name: Palmetto Dunes Lagoon Charter
services.desc: Try some of the best fishing on Hilton Head Island - all while in the flat, calm waters of the Palmetto Dunes Resort lagoon system. A nursery to a variety of saltwater fish species, this lagoon system holds giant redfish, trout, bluefish, black drum, flounder and even tarpon. Take a Hilton Head Island fishing charter led by one of our native guides in a quiet, electric skiff. blurb: The waters around Hilton Head Island, South Carolina, offer anglers a wide range of inshore fishing opportunities. Palmetto Lagoon Charters offers anglers fly rod and light tackle fishing charters for full or half-day fishing trips around Hilton Head Island. Our Hilton Head Island fishing charters are sure to give you a workout that leaves your arms aching and your heart pounding.

quotes.text: My brother, nephew and I went out with Captain Stacey in the lagoon and we had an absolute blast! My 9 year old nephew loved catching the trout and is saying it was the highlight of our vacation. Would highly recommend this trip to anyone who wants to catch big fish without going out into the ocean.

Trent was a true expert on the water and put us on more fish than we could keep. Even with unfavorable wind and less than normal water visibility, he knew exactly where to put the boat and the bait! It was an honor fishing with this gentleman and I can’t wait to do it again!

You can’t do better than Captain Trent Malphrus. Even when fishing is tough, Trent will find fish!! He has indispensable local knowledge which he uses to his advantage. Have always had a great time especially when with kids!

We had a great morning with Captain Trent. He obviously knows his stuff and we will be back to fish with him again. I have used six different charters over the past six years and this was by far the best.
Captain Trent is amazing! My Dad and I thoroughly enjoyed every minute of our trip! It was a pleasure being out on the water with someone so knowledgeable...
Captain Trent and his team are the best in the Low Country. If you go to Hilton Head, take the time to book a trip. It's well worth it.
